sources.title: YOLOv3, and YOLOv3u | Ultralytics
sources.snippet: YOLOv3-Ultralytics is Ultralytics' adaptation of YOLOv3 that adds support for more pretrained models and facilitates easier model customization. YOLOv3u is an upgraded variant of YOLOv3-Ultralytics, integrating the anchor-free, objectness-free split head from YOLOv8, improving detection robustness and accuracy for various object sizes.
